entities.name: Sándor Simonyi-Semadam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sándor Simonyi-Semadam was a Hungarian politician who served as prime minister for a few months in 1920. He signed the Treaty of Trianon after World War I on 4 June 1920. By this treaty, Hungary lost a considerable part of its territory. Simonyi was a member of the Hungarian-Nippon Society, a society for creating cultural links between Japan and Hungary. On 4 June 1946, Simonyi-Semadam died at his home in Budapest.

entities.summary: Sándor Simonyi-Semadam was a Hungarian politician who served as prime minister for a few months in 1920. He signed the Treaty of Trianon after World War I on 4 June 1920. By this treaty, Hungary lost a considerable part of its territory. Simonyi was a member of the Hungarian-Nippon Society, a society for creating cultural links between Japan and Hungary. On 4 June 1946, Simonyi-Semadam died at his home in Budapest.
